“This shop grew out of that barrel.”— The DuniaPur Story
Cold-Pressed, Nothing Else Added

It started with one barrel of honest mustard oil.

Founded in 2021 by three friends who couldn't find honest mustard oil for their own kitchens. They went to Okara, found a grower, and bought a barrel.

Today we buy directly from growers in Okara, Chitral, Hunza and Khairpur — and press at room temperature in small batches. No heat, no hexane, no bleaching. Seed goes into the press and oil comes out the same day. Cloudy in the bottle is the point — that is the oil, not a filtrate of it.

We never blend, never relabel, and never make health claims we can't prove.
